title: In-Flight Revenge Video: Woman Teaches Man A Lesson For Resting Bare Feet On Her Seat. Internet Says, 'If He Were Indian...' | Viral News - News18
text: Air travel often comes with its share of discomforts: cramped seats, limited legroom, long delays and occasionally inconsiderate passengers. A recent incident has gone viral after two women decided to teach a lesson to a man who had rested his foot on the back of her seat. Their creative revenge on the fellow flyer took everyone by surprise. In a video circulating online, a male passenger is seen sleeping with his legs stretched onto the seat in front of him, his bare feet placed on top of the window seat, clearly causing discomfort to the woman ahead. Instead of reacting with anger or escalating the situation, the women opted for a hilarious form of justice. What Did The Women Do? Any guesses? The women painted the man’s toenails bright red. While one sneaked up to ensure he remained asleep, the other pulled out a bottle of red nail polish and carried out her cheeky revenge. To everyone’s surprise, the fellow passengers didn’t intervene. Instead, they quietly filmed the entire act, laughing as the woman completed her impromptu makeover without waking the man. Social Media Users Gave A Thumbs Up To The Idea The video has since gained massive traction, with users debating between applause and concern. Many praised the woman for teaching a lesson without saying a word, while others criticised the man for his lack of etiquette. Some social media users sympathised with the man, assuming tiredness might have led to his behaviour. “Well done. He deserves this," read a comment. Another said, “How absolutely disgusting. Taking your socks off was the first offence! Putting it on the seat, strike two. And hovering it over someone’s head is strike three." “If he were Indian, everyone would be teaching him civic sense," wrote a user. An individual sympathised with the man and said, “It is funny, but the guy is not rude… he is tired." “Some people are saying that he might be tired. But being tired is NO EXCUSE for this," replied a user. An Instagram user shared, “Good for her. Last summer, when I was on a bus in Queens, NY, a man was nasty and disrespectful towards a teen girl because she was wearing a summer outfit. He fell asleep. She rubbed lipstick on his white NY Mets jersey." “Perfect lesson for him. You should have painted his feet too," suggested a user. Another one said, “He had his legs up on someone else’s seat? That’s very rude and does not deserve empathy." Similar Incident On A Train Earlier in April, a train passenger shared a picture of a woman resting her bare foot on the tray table during a journey. Posted on X (formerly Twitter), the image showed the woman lying across the seats, with one foot on the seat and the other on the tray. The post quickly went viral online and garnered mixed reactions. While some users argued that many don’t follow basic manners in public, others defended the woman, claiming that long train journeys with cramped seating often make people uncomfortable.
